title: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 13.6 Binomial Theorem: Apply the Binomial Theorem.
summary: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, 13.6 Binomial Theorem: Apply the Binomial Theorem.
body: OpenStax Algebra and Trigonometry 2e, section "13.6 Binomial Theorem", prints these objectives: "Apply the Binomial Theorem.". The section text says: "A polynomial with two terms is called a binomial. We have already learned to multiply binomials and to raise binomials to powers, but raising a binomial to a high power can be tedious and time-consuming. In this section, we will discuss a shortcut that will allow us to find ( x + y ) n without multiplying the binomial by itself n times." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
